deploybot: Initiating tagged hotpatch deploy v1.9.8-patch1 -> prod-eu1
deploybot: Commit: 9f3b2a7 (https://git.redwood.ai/infra/serving/commit/9f3b2a7)
deploybot: Release notes: small tokenizer fix + KV cache eviction guard (no schema changes). Change window: 15m. Initiated by @alex (eng-release).
alex (eng-release): quick note: this is targeted patch for request-size OOM in long-context jobs; zero downtime expected.
mia (oncall): watching metrics and traces, will post smoke results in ~5m :eyes:
samir (qa): running smoke suite against canary-0. Link to run: https://ci.redwood.ai/1234
deploybot: Canary 0 promoted (instance id i-canary-42). Health checks: passing. 200/200 OK. latency p95 ~ 68ms.
mia (oncall): perf looks fine so far. error-rate steady.
alex (eng-release): rolling to 20% -> 50% -> all over the next 10m. flag if any anomalous errors.
release-custodian: note: pinned metric alert for tokenizer-latency is active at +30% threshold.
monitoring-bot: Alert: tokenizer_latency_eu1 p95 increased by 38% on host pool prod-eu1-cpu-3 in last 60s :warning:
mia (oncall): seeing the spike, isolating to a small subset of workloads that hit long-context path.
samir (qa): can reproduce locally with same inputs, failing on kv-eviction NPE in 1/200 requests.
alex (eng-release): ok pausing rollout at 50%. switching to emergency rollback? thoughts?
mia (oncall): recommend immediate rollback to v1.9.7 while we triage. will notify infra to stop further promos.
alex (eng-release): agreed. initiating rollback now.
deploybot: Rollback: promoting tagged release v1.9.7 -> prod-eu1. Rollback initiated by @alex. Steps: drain 50% -> swap -> postflight checks.
deploybot: Rollback complete. v1.9.7 is now the active tag on prod-eu1. Postflight health: 200/200 OK, latency p95 back to ~52ms.
release-custodian: filed incident doc: https://incidents.redwood.ai/2026-03-20-tokenizer-eviction-fail (short postmortem to follow).
mia (oncall): continuing to monitor for 15m. samir can you create a minimal repro and open a PR for the fix?
samir (qa): will do, uploading repro and stack trace to the ticket now. PR target branch hotfix/v1.9.8-fix.
alex (eng-release): thanks team. we'll re-cut a patch once fix validated. tagging this thread: postflight+rollback-notes :white_check_mark:
deploybot: Deployment session closed. duration 9m 45s. Logged events to release-run-2234567890.
